front.prompt:
Create ONE independent front-facing character sprite on a genuinely transparent SQUARE canvas, for Samto Chess. Final animation-input design is 256x256 pixels. If rendered larger, use an enlarged 256-pixel grid with hard stepped square pixel clusters, 2-3px dark navy outlines and simple two/three flat shades at final 256. No background, baked checkerboard, shadow, floor, text, border, effects or other characters. Pure front idle stance.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is this character's old 256-layout: preserve its BODY scale, ground line y224 and center x128, weapon reach and cavalry/infantry body composition. Redesign costume/head as instructed, do not fill the whole square. Image 2 is APPROVED new Zhao Yun: match its chunky pixel drawing, simple face, sparse shading and legible armor; DO NOT borrow his silver helmet, white cape or horse for unrelated heroes. Image 3 is our Xu Chu comparison: match the same sprite family, flat pixel shading and square eyes. If Image 4 exists, it is an official KOEI portrait for IDENTITY ONLY (headgear, beard, armor), never copy its realism, composition or fine ornament.
CANVAS CONTRACT: Virtual 256x256, ground/feet y224, center x128. Infantry body stays approximately 125-145px tall and around 55-75px wide according to Image1; large muscle/body variants can be broader without becoming taller giants. Scholars and women visibly slimmer. Cavalry total body with horse around180px tall, weapon may reach y20-30, compact horse no gigantic scaling. Preserve first reference's proportional body group. Same ground in every character. Clear transparent margin for motion. Body scale is NOT determined by weapon's bounding box. Complete spear/blade, hair, cape and all feet/hooves inside frame. Keep some empty space above and to sides. Avoid decorative complexity. Stand on feet, or clearly sit astride horse when mounted. Correct hands gripping handles not blades. Meaningful outfit differences; no generic topknot+white-fur+gold-lion formula.
DESIGN TO DRAW: Guan Yu: majestic mature red-brown face, very long straight black beard, green folded headcloth, green robe over muted gold/steel armor, broad composed eyes. Mounted on existing chestnut horse, hold complete Green Dragon crescent glaive. Preserve iconic green silhouette, no helmet or giant gold horse mask.

back.prompt:

Independent sprite only, no sheet, text, shadow, scenery, floor or baked checkerboard. Real transparent background.

Adult small-bodied and broad-bodied differences from reference must remain.
One static neutral idle pose with original equipment. Complete silhouette with substantial motion room around it. No movement or special effects.
